verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a public, OpenAI-compatible inference API at api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai, with request parameters such as service_tier, fail_fast and reasoning_effort. It also serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec (132 paths) with a vendor-hosted Swagger UI for live try-it-out requests. The 404 probes on deepinfra.com paths are explained by the spec living on api.deepinfra.com, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: an API-surface versioning/deprecation policy and changelog (changelog.md answers 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Point your existing OpenAI SDK to `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` and your code works without changes.
